text: Diagnosis/diagnoses: 1. Resected rectosigmoid colon with a deeply ulcerated, extensive, moderately. differentiated adenocarcinoma of the colorectal type with widespread infiltration of. the perirectal fatty tissue and two local lymph node metastases. In this section the. tumor extends to the circumferential resection margin. Tumor-free mesenteric. resection margin. Tumor-free colon resection margins. 2. & 3. Both periureteral soft tissue samples with infiltration of the carcinoma. described. Stage of tumor: pT4, pN1 (2/17) pMX; G2, L1, V0, R2.
